title: Correct friction coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the correct coefficient of kinetic friction, μ = 0.5.

title: Correct equilibrium conclusion
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly conclude that the object is not in equilibrium when F₂ is applied.

title: Correct acceleration value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct acceleration magnitude, a = 7 m/s².

title: Force balance for constant velocity
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's first law to the first case, balancing the applied force, gravitational component, and kinetic friction.

title: Correct normal force calculation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly calculate the normal force as N = mg cos θ = 8 N for both cases.

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important Criteria: For the second case, the solution must apply Newton's second law along the incline, accounting for all forces correctly.

title: Friction direction consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the direction of the kinetic friction force is incorrectly assigned (e.g., same direction as motion in the second case).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize significant sign errors in force summations or omission/incorrect use of units in final answers.
